title: The Modest man at the counter
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：modest　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 modest 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the guide wrote of ① a modest man at the counter in the guidebook, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② more modest than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the guide, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the modest ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most modest man at the counter anybody in the valley had ever seen, or so the guidebook for July 1980 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too modest to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the modest ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a modest sum for the work, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as modest as the sum for the work they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was modest or not, and he said so.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something modest, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite modest; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the guidebook kept the names of the modest ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996, at once, she wrote of another modest man at the counter in the same guidebook, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more modest than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most modest sum for the work in the whole valley, she said in 1998, was the one she could never quite name; the modest ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 谦虚（前置定语 a modest man at the counter：1986 年向导在旅行手册里记下的那件谦虚的男人）
B. adj. 谦虚／不算多（比较级 more modest than：文中两处，一处比柜台后谦逊的男人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 谦虚／不算多（最高级 the most modest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 谦虚（表语 too modest to do：母亲觉得它太谦虚，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 不算多（前置定语 a modest sum for the work：叔叔把整件事称作一桩不算多的报酬）
F. adj. 不算多（同级比较 as modest as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩一笔不算多的报酬相比）
G. adj. 不算多（后置定语 something modest：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 不算多（受程度副词修饰 quite modest：那位旅人的评价）

items.q: a modest man at the counter
the most modest man at the counter anybody
a modest sum for the work
The most modest sum for the work in

answers.why: modest 意为“谦虚”，1986 年向导在旅行手册里记下的是“一件谦虚的男人”，此处作前置定语 a modest man at the counter。
modest 意为“谦虚”，此处用比较级 more modest than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
modest 意为“谦虚”，旅行手册上 七月 那行字说它是山谷里最谦虚的一件，故用最高级 the most modest man at the counter。
modest 意为“谦虚”，母亲认为这件东西“太谦虚了，谁也用不上”，too modest to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
modest 意为“不算多”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩不算多的报酬”，此处作前置定语 a modest sum for the work。
modest 意为“不算多”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩一笔不算多的报酬一样不算多”，同级比较用 as modest as。
modest 意为“不算多”，旅行手册上那半行字要的是“不算多的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something modest。
modest 意为“不算多”，邻山谷来的那位旅人认为这套计划“相当不算多”，quite 修饰原级 modest。
modest 意为“不算多”，1996 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要不算多”，故用比较级 more modest than。
modest 意为“不算多”，母亲 1998 年说的是“整个山谷里最不算多的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most modest sum for the work。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，向导在旅行手册里记下了一件谦虚的男人。（a modest man at the counter）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更谦虚。（more modest than …）
母亲觉得它太谦虚，谁也用不上。（too modest to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩不算多的报酬。（a modest sum for the work）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩一笔不算多的报酬一样不算多。（as modest as …）
到了 1993 年，旅行手册上只剩半行字：要的是一件不算多的东西。（something modest）
answers: In 1986 the guide wrote of a modest man at the counter in the guidebook.
Everybody said it was more modest than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too modest to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a modest sum for the work.
He said nobody would call it as modest as the sum for the work they had once had.
By 1993 the guidebook asked for nothing but something modest.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 modest 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the guide wrote of a modest man at the counter in the guidebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most modest man at the counter in the valley, or so the guidebook says.
My mother thought it too modest to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a modest sum for the work, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next valley called the plan quite modest, and everybody laughed.
The modest ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
